attributes.title: Clinical & Macro Conference 2027
attributes.organizer: National Association of Social Workers, Maryland Chapter
attributes.summary:
NASW Maryland's Clinical & Macro Conference takes place on September 23 and 24, 2027, at The Maritime Institute conference center in Linthicum Heights. As the name says, the two-day program is built for both clinicians and macro practitioners working in community organizing, policy, administration and supervision.

The chapter has posted the dates and venue as a save-the-date. Session topics, fees and the number of continuing education hours are not yet listed. NASW Maryland labels its programs by Maryland CE category, and members get free or discounted CE at chapter events.

Social workers who need Category I hours, ethics or supervision content for a Maryland renewal should check the chapter page once the agenda is posted.
